title: Static Burn
origin: A relay surge burned a second signal into the operative's thoughts.
burdenText: The first Signal test each round suffers -1.
adaptationText: Once per game, ignore one owner-only immediate Blue Event effect.
text: A neural scar from signal lash and broken ward feedback.
flavor: Old route prayers come back as noise when you try to sleep.
trigger: The first anomaly or signal check you face each session.
penalty: Gain a static note as the scar starts broadcasting through you.

effect.text: Static Burn broadcast a warning through the operative.

relief: Spend a charged artifact charge before the check to ignore this scar for that encounter.
upside: If the check succeeds anyway, gain 1 trophy from the clean reading.
